definitions.explanation: One's level of proficiency or skill in a particular activity, especially practical or technical skills.

examples.japanese: {料理|りょうり}の{腕前|うでまえ}を{上|あ}げる。
{彼|かれ}の{腕前|うでまえ}は{相当|そうとう}なものだ。
{腕前|うでまえ}を{試|ため}してみたい。
examples.english: I want to test my skills.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{腕|うで} (arm) + {前|まえ} (front, quality) → quality of one's arm = skill

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{腕前|うでまえ}を{上|あ}げる - to improve one's skills
・{腕前|うでまえ}を{試|ため}す - to test one's skills
・{腕前|うでまえ}を{披露|ひろう}する - to show off one's skills
・{腕前|うでまえ}が{光|ひか}る - one's skills shine

USAGE:
{腕前|うでまえ} is commonly used for practical skills like cooking, sports, or craftsmanship. It emphasizes demonstrated ability rather than innate talent.

RELATED WORDS:
・{技術|ぎじゅつ} - technique, technology
・{技|わざ} - skill, technique
・{凄腕|すごうで} - highly skilled, expert
・{敏腕|びんわん} - capable, competent
